items.html: Now beneath Bina, at its end beneath its Malchut, stand these 320 sparks, which are the seven kings, and through the arousal of these judgments that are there, she becomes heated and couples with Aba. And these 320, in gematria, are “friends” [re'im]: for through them Aba and Ima become friends to one another, and they couple by the secret of eating, as it is written, “Eat, O friends.” And as it is written, “she has eaten and wiped her mouth,” which is an allusion to the coupling.
